formal_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph m N) (s b D : ℕ) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin m × Fin N))), PEqualNP.Expanders.IsBdryExpander G s 2 → PEqualNP.Expanders.LeftDegLe G b → 2 * (D + 1) ≤ s → 32 ≤ D → 2 * b ≤ D → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PHP m N) π → Real.exp (((D : ℝ) ^ 2) / (256 * ((b : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)))) ≤ 2 * (π.length : ℝ)
plain_statement: For ANY numbers of pigeons m and holes N: if some bipartite graph on them has left degree at most b and every set of at most s pigeons has twice its size in unique neighbours, with 2(D+1) <= s, D >= 32 and D >= 2b, then every dag-like Res(+) refutation of the pigeonhole formula PHP m N has at least exp(D^2 / (256 b m)) / 2 lines. What the checked chain (L-pcx-042, 046, 047) gives as a function of m: it is empty once m passes about D^2, so near m = n^2. The baseline for the weak pigeonhole target.
title: Baseline for weak pigeonhole: a Res(+) refutation of PHP m N has at least exp(D^2 / (256 b m)) / 2 lines when some degree-b graph expands sets up to 2(D+1)
